Les résidents du quartier Ben Slimane El: Residents of the Ben Slimane El Miloud neighborhood, located in the municipality of Ammaria (wilaya of Tizi Ouzou), have publicly appealed to Algérie Télécom to report a persistent degradation of their internet service. In a post shared on social media, they point the finger at the dilapidated state of the copper cables and wires supplying their sector, which are unable to support current traffic. This equipment, deemed obsolete, generates frequent interruptions and particularly low speeds, depriving subscribers of a stable connection despite regular payment of their fees.
Face à ces difficultés, les habitants on: Faced with these difficulties, the residents have formulated two priority requests: the immediate dispatch of a technical team to inspect and maintain the existing cables, as well as the inclusion of their neighborhood in upcoming modernization plans. Their ultimate goal remains the complete replacement of the copper network with a fiber optic infrastructure (FTTH), a solution presented as the only one capable of permanently eliminating these malfunctions. Algérie Télécom has responded by engaging in concrete actions to address these concerns.
Engagement d’Algérie Télécom pour la fib: Algérie Télécom's commitment to fiber optics
Dans sa réponse aux habitants, Algérie T: In its response to the residents, Algérie Télécom confirmed the admissibility of their complaint and announced immediate measures to remedy the situation. The operator specified that a technical mission would be dispatched to the site to assess the state of the infrastructure and carry out the necessary urgent repairs. Furthermore, it reaffirmed its commitment to integrating the Ben Slimane El Miloud neighborhood into ongoing modernization projects, with the objective of deploying FTTH technology.
